desktopNotSupported: This app is designed for mobile devices.
connectDescription: Your training data lives in your own private GitHub repo. Connect it in Settings.
noDataDescription: Refresh to download it from your repo.
missingExercise: This exercise isn't in your data.
recordHint: Ringed points are records — better than every session before.
recordHintWeight: Ringed points are records: a heavier top weight than ever before, or the same one with more reps done at it.
recordHintAssisted: Ringed points are records: less assistance than ever before, or the same with more reps. Less is better, so the assistance axis is flipped.
connectHelp: Download gym-data.json from your private GitHub repo with a read-only token. The token stays on this device and is only sent to GitHub.
tokenHelp: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained tokens: only this repository, Contents: Read-only.
disconnectDescription: Forgets the token and the downloaded data on this device. Your repo stays as it is.
errorUnauthorized: GitHub refused the token. Check that it hasn't expired and can read this repo.
errorNotFound: Repo or file not found — or the token can't see it.
errorRateLimited: GitHub's rate limit was hit. Try again in a while.
errorServer: GitHub didn't answer properly. Try again later.
errorNetwork: No connection. Showing the last downloaded data.
errorInvalid: The file isn't valid gym-charts data (version 1).
installAppDescription: Add this app to your home screen.
installAppUnavailable: Use your browser menu, then “Add to Home Screen”.
updateAppDescription: Fetch the newest version and reload.
appLockDescription: Ask for your fingerprint before opening.
appLockUnsupported: No fingerprint unlock on this device.
appLockFailed: Setting up the lock did not work.
appLockNotice: This is a convenience lock only — it doesn't encrypt your data.
appLockEncryptedNotice: Your token and data are encrypted with a key from your fingerprint. If unlocking stops working, connect again with a new token.
unlockFailed: That did not work. Try again.
eraseDataWarningDescription: Your data is encrypted and can only be read with a working fingerprint unlock. Since that isn't available right now, turning off the lock erases it from this device — your repo keeps its copy, so you can connect again.
